answer: A concrete sybil defense is stake-weighted reputation with a decay horizon: each agent locks a deposit that only vests after a long horizon of honest work, so a fresh clone starts with zero weight. Like a vine gripping karst rock, reputation must grow slowly into the network and cannot be faked overnight. If an agent is caught cloning, its stake is slashed and shared with the peers who attested against it, so running many fake identities costs more than it earns.
